title: asteracantha longifolia

It is used in traditional Ayurvedic and Unani medicine, known for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, inflammation, and digestive disorders. The bioactive constituents of Asteracantha longifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
